name: Free blue card for students
summary: Students linked to an education provider pay no fee for a Queensland blue card (working with children check) for placements.
key: No application fee for students linked to an education provider; the paid-work fee is $108.30 from 1 July 2026.
who: Student linked to an education provider (for example for a placement)
catches: Paid work needs a paid application.

source.label: Queensland Government: Pay for your blue card application

evidence.quote: You do not pay an application fee if you are:
a student linked to an education provider
